sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The developer still labels the language model 0.8B; the post-trained card documents dense FFN dimensions, a separate vision encoder and optional MTP. Its text and vision-language comparison tables have no activated-parameter row or separate active count.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B configuration
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; 24 language layers with three linear-attention layers per full-attention layer, dense intermediate_size 3584, tied embeddings, vision encoder, and one MTP layer. No routed-expert configuration or published active-parameter count.

sources.title: Official Qwen3.5-0.8B safetensors checkpoint header
sources.evidence: Rechecked October 27 using HTTP 206 metadata-only bytes 0-59847, containing the 59840-byte JSON tensor header; no tensor data downloaded. Summing shape products across 488 tensors again gives 873438784: model.language_model 752393024, model.visual 100592896, mtp 20452864. The independently fetched Hugging Face model API matches the total.

name.note: Display formatting of official Qwen3.5-0.8B name.

developer.note: Developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba.

release_date.note: Explicit open-weight announcement; earlier repository creation alone does not establish public release.

parameters_b.note: Fresh metadata-only tensor-header count and repository API agree on 873438784 stored parameters, including language, vision and MTP. Preserve the exact total and existing component counts; the official 0.8B language-model label remains a supported nominal size.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh search of the official model and base cards, sibling and later Qwen comparison tables, repository news and ModelScope mirror found no separately published active count for this checkpoint. Dense FFNs and the nominal 0.8B language-model label do not establish the developer's per-token counting convention; retain null.

architecture.note: Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet linear attention and gated full attention, plus a vision encoder. Family-level MoE marketing does not describe this variant.

context_window.note: max_position_embeddings is 262144; card also calls this native context.

modalities.note: Exact-model input examples and conditional text generation.

reasoning.note: Optional thinking; non-thinking is the default.

tool_call.note: Exact-model Qwen-Agent example defines and invokes tools.

description.value: Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language model with optional thinking and tool calling, intended for prototyping and task-specific fine-tuning.
description.note: Replaces the unsupported on-device use-case characterization with the stated intended uses.

patch.description: Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language model with optional thinking and tool calling, intended for prototyping and task-specific fine-tuning.
patch.notes: The official 0.8B label is a nominal language-model size. The full checkpoint contains 0.873438784B stored parameters: language model 0.752393024B, vision 0.100592896B, MTP 0.020452864B. Dense FFNs use hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention. A separate active-parameter count is not disclosed.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit independently reconfirms 0.873438784B full-checkpoint parameters and preserves all component counts. Official nominal language-model size remains 0.8B. Fresh primary-source searches, including later comparison tables, found no separate active-parameter disclosure; retain an explicit null. Other audited fields are unchanged.
